triggers.scheduled: daily at 03:00 UTC (layer 0), weekly (layer 1), monthly (layer 2), quarterly (layer 3)

routine: verify candidate dependency updates in a sandbox before adoption
0.adoption: a candidate update is adopted only after the self-check suite passes against it

routine: verify skill package hashes against their declared sources
1.adoption: memory consolidation is adopted when no referenced source is lost

routine: review in-flight tasks and their skill bindings
2.adoption: plans may change freely; commitments made to counterparties are only changed through the task mechanism that governs them

routine: replay recorded failures against candidate strategies
3.adoption: a candidate strategy is adopted only after at least 20 replayed cases or two independent evaluation windows show improvement

disclosure.terms: cycle record documents are published with findings and evaluation summaries; memory and cognition contents are disclosed to named parties only
